prompt: In tenpin bowling, how many pins stand at the end of the lane at the start of a frame?
explanation: Tenpin bowling uses ten pins, arranged in a triangle with four rows: one pin at the front, then two, then three, then four at the back. Knocking down all ten with one ball is a strike.
